mapper.sql: ID, ALERT_ID, HANDLER, HANDLE_TIME, HANDLE_RESULT, HANDLE_METHOD, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.update: UPDATE CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD SET HANDLE_RESULT = #{handleResult}, HANDLE_METHOD = #{handleMethod}, REMARK = #{remark}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD WHERE ALERT_ID = #{alertId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD WHERE HANDLER = #{handler} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT HANDLE_METHOD as method, COUNT(*) as count FROM CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD WHERE HANDLE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY HANDLE_METHOD
SELECT HANDLE_RESULT as result, COUNT(*) as count FROM CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD WHERE HANDLE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY HANDLE_RESULT
SELECT HANDLER, COUNT(*) as count FROM CLOUDWALK.ALERT_HANDLING_RECORD WHERE HANDLE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY HANDLER
